visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A teenage boy with black hair wearing a black graphic t-shirt and an adult woman with brown hair in a white t-shirt sit on a gray fabric sofa. Behind them is a large framed traditional painting with Chinese text and lotus flowers. The lighting is bright and even. A hand enters from the bottom, pointing a finger at the duo. (2) The boy holds a small orange lollipop in his right hand and a white rectangular bar of soap in his left. He looks at the camera with a serious, concentrated expression. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. The background remains the same living room setting with a headset visible on the couch to the right. (3) The boy performs the challenge by switching his hands' positions and responding to commands. He maintains a calm facial posture. The woman beside him watches with a slight smile, resting her chin on her hand. Large variety-show style text captions in yellow and white flash on the screen. (4) The woman takes the lollipop and soap. She looks nervous and then laughs hysterically, her mouth wide open and eyes squinted, as she mistakenly brings the soap to her mouth. The boy laughs beside her. The camera shakes slightly, suggesting a handheld filming style. (5) A young man in a blue denim shirt sits on the same sofa, holding the items. He looks at the camera with a playful smile. He reacts to a command by putting the lollipop in his mouth but then laughs as he realizes he was supposed to smell the soap. Yellow text asks for shares to slow-reacting friends.
